title: Boiler Inspection Maintenance Log
subtitle: Boiler Inspection: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Boiler Inspection Maintenance Log covers boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop. The facility boiler coordinator records Boiler Inspection events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Boiler Inspection Maintenance Log keeps Boiler Inspection exceptions visible until the facility boiler coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Boiler Inspection Maintenance Log at boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system. Document boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop identity before Boiler Inspection begins. Compare boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop findings with stated Boiler Inspection criteria; route unresolved Boiler Inspection issues to qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer. For Boiler Inspection Maintenance Log, confirm requirements for Boiler Inspection. Ask qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer to review Boiler Inspection conditions beyond the facility boiler coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Boiler Inspection, identify responsible parties, boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system, and the linked boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop source.

fields.label: Make, model, serial, rating, fuel, and permit reference
Operating schedule, service history, and inspection basis

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Boiler Inspection facts for boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Boiler Inspection tracked controls
items: Visible vessel, piping, valve, pump, and leak condition
Burner, flame, fuel-train, and ignition observation
Vent, draft, combustion-air, and room condition
Pressure, temperature, level, and makeup-water indication
Limit, cutoff, relief, alarm, and control response
Startup, operating, shutdown, and lockout sequence

sections.title: Status decision and next trigger
sections.guidance: For Boiler Inspection, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Facility Boiler Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Low-water, limit, relief, or cutoff failure
Unsafe pressure, temperature, venting, or vessel condition
Test requires authority or shutdown not available
Combustion or operating readings by instrument
blocks.guidance: Pause Boiler Inspection when a fuel, combustion, pressure-boundary, venting, or required safety-control concern remains. Retain the available Boiler Inspection proof and route unresolved boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop scope to facility boiler coordinator.
